name: CS2 Tracker
author: wildesPepega@users.noreply.github.com
description: Discord bot that watches Counter-Strike 2 (730, DevClient 2275500, DevServer 2275530) via Steam PICS for changelists, builds and depot changes, and posts CS2 blog posts and @CounterStrike Twitter banner changes. Updates itself automatically.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# CS2 Tracker install script
# Downloads the matching prebuilt release binary from GitHub.
set -euo pipefail

REPO="wildesPepega/cs2-tracker"

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64|amd64)  ARCH="x86_64" ;;
    aarch64|arm64) ARCH="aarch64" ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

if [ -z "${VERSION:-}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    URL="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/latest/download/cs2-tracker-linux-${ARCH}"
else
    URL="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/download/${VERSION}/cs2-tracker-linux-${ARCH}"
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

echo "Downloading ${URL}"
curl -fsSL -o cs2-tracker.new "${URL}"
chmod +x cs2-tracker.new
mv cs2-tracker.new cs2-tracker

# state.json is kept on reinstall so nothing gets posted twice.
echo "Installation complete."
